title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: the metadata save and publish doors refuse a select field bound to a picklist no loaded package declares
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB7J3TmFTYMYQrfpye6GQNg9)_ Fixes #29898 Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the metadata save door (draft and live), the per-item and package publish, and the restore doors refuse an `object` or `object_extension` whose field names a picklist no loaded package declares, a body they accepted before. Nothing is widened. Metadata-protocol: narrowed Skills-docs: no move — `skills/**` teaches no picklist REFERENCE verdict (the two mentions are "a picklist-bound field's options are never patchable" and the stack-key list), and `content/docs/**` carries no severity table for this reference; the prescription ships in the refusal text, the changeset's FROM → TO and the new upgrade-guide entry. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：对象（以及对象扩展）里 select / multiselect 字段绑定到一个"本环境没有任何包声明"的 picklist 时，元数据保存门、单项与整包发布、以及回滚/还原门现在直接 422 拒绝并点名字段与那个清单；以前存下来并发布成功，字段被服务成"零选项"，之后对该字段的每次写入都被拒。 - 为什么改：启动与后装载早就拒绝这个形状，`os validate` / `os build` 也拒绝栈内字段，只有运行时写入这道门放行，作者（或经 API 写元数据的 agent）拼错一个清单名就得到一张永远存不进数据的字段，且 `_diagnostics.valid: true` 什么都不提示。 - 风险与回滚：收窄写入门。对象已持有的绑定不重判（再保存照旧成功），`migrate-stored` 自愈不判；此前存下的草稿会在发布时被拒（它本来就让该字段写入全部失败）。回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据迁移。 - 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`（新判定 `unknownPicklistBindingSaveRefusal`，"已持有绑定"豁免是风险 hunk）、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`（保存门与发布晋升的接入点、方法文档）、`packages/cli/src/utils/picklist-references.boot-parity.test.ts`（两道门判定一致的 pin）。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-picklist-binding-door.test.ts`，预期 5 项全过：未声明清单在对象与 `.custom` 扩展上各被拒一次，依赖包的清单、`.custom` 基包的清单、同环境另一个已安装包的清单各自保存+发布成功并被服务上选项。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地（本 PR 动了 `packages/spec` 的迁移条目，按席位安排走 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 复核）。 ## What changes The dangling-reference refusal family at the metadata save door gains its picklist member. - **New judge** — `unknownPicklistBindingSaveRefusal` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`, beside `unknownGrantObjectSaveRefusal` (#28990) and `unknownDatasourceSaveRefusal` (#26724), whose shape it follows. It judges an `object` and an `object_extension` body (an extension's fields join the object it extends, so the object it names is `extend`), reads which picklists the body's fields name through the boot audit's own walk (`collectPicklistReferences`, `@objectstack/metadata/picklist-references`; the `os validate` door walks the parsed artifact with its own reader and agrees with this door by pin, not by sharing the walk), and refuses `422 INVALID_METADATA` with one finding per unknown binding at `fields.FIELD.picklist`, naming the field and the list. - **What counts as declared** — the engine registry's own `resolvePicklistOptions`, the read that SERVES a bound field's options. So the package's own list, a dependency's, the base package's of a `.custom` pair and any other package installed here all resolve, and the judge cannot offer a field options the write door then refuses. A registry that cannot answer the question refuses nothing (the posture `unknownGrantObjectSaveRefusal` takes for `getObject`). - **Where it is asked** — `saveMetaItem` after the schema gate, in draft and in publish mode (a `migrate-stored` re-save excepted, the platform healing its own storage); `promoteDraftForPublish` on the draft body, so a draft stored before this rule, or one whose list went between its save and its publish, is refused and a batch publish aborts on it; and the restore doors through `refuseRestoredBodyTheSaveDoorRefuses`. - **Not judged twice** — a binding the object's current definition already holds on that field is not this write's: a re-save, a stored-row migration or a restore that keeps it passes, and a list that has gone since is not the re-saving author's to answer for. There is no pending arm, because `picklist` is not runtime-creatable (`allowRuntimeCreate: false`), so no draft of a batch can declare one. - **`packages/spec`** — one ADR-0087 semantic upgrade-guide entry, `picklist-binding-unknown-refused`. ⛔ No schema shape under `packages/spec/src/**` is touched (the order's stop condition): `FieldSchema.picklist` is unchanged, and the refusal is a door judgement against the registry, not a Zod refinement — the verdict depends on which packages are installed, which a schema cannot see. - **`packages/cli`** — one source comment in the `os validate` / `os build` picklist judge. It said the runtime metadata write path "is not judged here" as a stated bound; it now names the door that judges it against the engine's registry. ### The measured surface shift (the dispatch's route was lint; the door is metadata-protocol) The order and the claim named "the author-time dangling-reference gate in `packages/lint`". Measured at `21510bba`, that is not where the precedent lives, and the seat accepted the shift before this PR was opened: - the lookup/reference arm of the reference-integrity suite (`validateObjectReferences`, which refuses a field's dangling `reference`) declares `runtimeTypes: ['flow', 'dataset']`, so it never judges an `object` write at the save door — a crossing is a `runtimeTypes` decision of its own, and an advisory-tier fence sits over that door (#4716); - the author-time picklist judge already exists and is deliberately NOT a lint registry rule: `packages/cli/src/utils/picklist-references.ts` says why in its header (the verdict depends on WHICH package declares the reference, and a registry rule is handed one flattened stack), and it names the runtime write path as its unjudged bound; - the save-door family that DOES refuse a dangling reference at the runtime doors is `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`. #29790's `objectRegistrationRefusal` is the registry pre-flight at the same door, which picklist resolution is not one of. So the fix joins that family, and no `packages/lint` file is touched (no overlap with #29926, which edits `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`). ## Tests Every reading below is from `objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this branch, each heavy command under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (slot `dev-29898`). The suites ran at `f04c956c`. Since then `d1809dd5` adds only `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` (the ledger row for the new test's engine double, written by the gate's own `--write`), and `8d7a02d5` corrects two source comments and adds the changeset's `Skills-docs:` line; no package or dogfood test reads either. | suite | reading | |:--|:--| | the new protocol pins + the restore-door family | `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 63 passed (63)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0` | | `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` whole package | `Test Files 312 passed | 4 skipped (316)`, `Tests 22339 passed | 26 skipped (22365)` | | the real-`SchemaRegistry` door test (`@objectstack/runtime`) | `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 5 passed (5)` | | the two-judge agreement pin (`@objectstack/cli`, `unit`) | `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 4 passed (4)` | | `@objectstack/cli` `unit` layer | `Tests 5279 passed | 29 skipped (5308)`; the two files that read the CLI's own `dist` (`published-subpath-console`, `published-subpath-hook-body`) re-run after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 29 passed (29)`. `integration` layer declared to CI (no integration-tier file touched) | | typecheck | `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/cli` `tsc --noEmit` clean (lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`) | | full dogfood battery at `f04c956c` (narrowing arm) | `Test Files 414 passed | 3 skipped (417)`, `Tests 3427 passed | 28 skipped (3455)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`, held 37m13s | New and changed pins: - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.unknown-picklist-binding-refusal.test.ts` (new) — through `saveMetaItem` (draft into a package, draft naming none, a publish save, a publish save under `force`), `publishMetaItem` and `publishPackageDrafts`: the envelope (`code`, `status`), the `issues[].path` set and the first sentence of each finding, nothing stored and nothing promoted; a `multiselect` judged as a `select`; an `object_extension` judged under the object it extends; a list that goes between a draft's save and its publish; the `migrate-stored` exemption; and the controls — a resolved list, no binding at all, a held binding on a list gone since (with the two re-binding cases that ARE refused), and a registry that cannot resolve a list. - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.restore-doors-save-refusal-family.test.ts` — one more member of the family it exists for, at both restore doors (`rollbackMetaItem`, `revertCommit`) with their controls. - `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-picklist-binding-door.test.ts` (new) — the real `SchemaRegistry` behind a real `ObjectQL` + `better-sqlite3`, a code base package, its `.custom` pair, a second installed list package and a runtime package: the two refusals, and the three "declared" controls each saved, published AND served with the list's options. - `packages/cli/src/utils/picklist-references.boot-parity.test.ts` — a second top-level `describe` in the harness that already pins this door against the boot (AGENTS.md: a new pin for a component with a shared harness file goes into that file). It answers the seat's ask directly: the two judges cannot share one judgement (this door reads the parsed artifact and weighs outside dependencies; the save door asks the live registry), so the agreement is pinned — on a list a SIBLING package of the same artifact owns, where they could disagree, and on a name nothing declares, where both refuse the same field (the paths are rooted in their own subjects, so the artifact-rooted path ends with the body-rooted one).
Ablation — each door's negative pins really fail without the fix (three legs) **Leg 1, the save door.** One leg, through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode: the save door's call site in `saveMetaItem` (the four lines that ask `unknownPicklistBindingSaveRefusal` and throw) replaced by a marker, anchor `x1 -> x0`, blob `becf5c5fcc0e -> 19085994bfa4`. The suite resolves `./protocol.js` from source, so no build sits between the mutation and the run. ``` × a draft save into a package is refused 422 at `fields..picklist` … × a draft save naming no package is refused 422 … × a publish save is refused 422 … × a publish save under `force` is refused 422 … × a `multiselect` is judged as a `select` is … × an `object_extension` field bound to an unknown list is refused the same way … × an author re-saving the same draft is still refused × a re-save that keeps a binding the object already holds on a list gone since … Test Files 1 failed (1) Tests 8 failed | 7 passed (15) ``` The 7 that stay green are the publish-door pins (their own call site in `promoteDraftForPublish` is untouched) and the controls — the direction expected. Restore: `blob after restore becf5c5fcc0e == blob at HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty. **Leg 2, the publish door.** The `throw` of the call site in `promoteDraftForPublish` replaced by a marker, anchor `x1 -> x0`, blob `becf5c5fcc0e -> f15546e7b85a`, same suite: ``` × publishMetaItem refuses it, and the draft stays a draft × publishPackageDrafts answers `refused`, names it, and promotes nothing of the batch × a list that goes between the draft save and its publish: the per-item publish is refused × `migrate-stored` is not judged by this door, and the draft's publish is still refused Test Files 1 failed (1) Tests 4 failed | 11 passed (15) ``` Exactly the three publish-door pins and the `migrate-stored` "publish is still refused" assertion; the save-door pins and the controls stay green. Restore: `blob after restore becf5c5fcc0e == blob at HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty. **Leg 3, the restore doors.** The `throw` in `refuseRestoredBodyTheSaveDoorRefuses` (`protocol-authoring-gate.ts`) replaced by a marker, anchor `x1 -> x0`, blob `a114a4c2f1ff -> e7d365211ff2`, `protocol.restore-doors-save-refusal-family.test.ts`: ``` × an object restored with a field bound to a picklist no loaded package declares now (unknownPicklistBindingSaveRefusal) > rollbackMetaItem: answers INVALID_METADATA / 422; nothing is stored × … > revertCommit: reports INVALID_METADATA in failed[]; nothing is stored Test Files 1 failed (1) Tests 2 failed | 46 passed (48) ``` Exactly the two picklist refusal cases of `pinBothDoors`; every other family member and the controls stay green. Restore: `blob after restore a114a4c2f1ff == blob at HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
## Acceptance notes - The boot's own refusal (`describeUnresolvedPicklistReferences`) is unchanged and still the authority for a package's own objects at load; this door is the authoring half it named as missing. - One deliberate divergence between the two judges, pre-existing on the CLI side: a list owned by a package that is installed in the same environment but is neither the stack itself, a sibling in the same artifact nor a declared dependency. The save door accepts it (the registry resolves it, and it is what the field will be served). `os validate` cannot see the environment, so it judges the stack alone, as it did before this PR. The new door never refuses a list the registry serves, so it cannot be stricter than the serve path; the runtime test pins that case as a control. - A copy is judged like any other write. `duplicatePackage` and the unmanaged import copy items through `saveMetaItem` in publish mode, and the copy target holds nothing yet, so a source object holding a binding on a list that is gone since is now refused when copied (the import rolls back). That is the same property `unknownGrantObjectSaveRefusal` (#28990) already gives those two paths, and it is right on the merits: the copy would be served with no options. - A tenant-authored body was already excluded from the boot audit on purpose (a stored row must not be able to fail a boot). That stays true: this judge refuses the WRITE, so the row never exists to be judged at boot. ## Verification - `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/x_probe?mode=draft&package=com.qa.x` with `fields.t = { type: 'select', picklist: 'nope_list' }` → `422 INVALID_METADATA`, finding at `fields.t.picklist` naming the field and `nope_list`; nothing stored, so `POST /api/v1/packages/com.qa.x/publish-drafts` has nothing of it to publish (the card's steps 2–5). - The same PUT with a picklist a package installed here declares → `200`, `publish-drafts` → `published`, `GET /api/v1/meta/object/x_probe` serves `t` with that list's options, and `POST /api/v1/data/x_probe` with one of its values → `200`.
Gate sweep — node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran: 95 derived families accounted for, 94 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED Every family `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this diff was run locally and recorded; `--ran` answers `✓ 95 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 94 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`. - 94 exit `0`. Five of them were green only on a second run, each for a reason outside the diff, with the fix noted: `check:engine-double-contract` (the new test's engine double had no ledger row; added by the gate's own `--write`, commit `d1809dd5`), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (needs full history; green after unshallowing the clone), `check:dts-closure` (spec `dist` was rebuilt at the same moment by the dogfood build; green on rerun, 225/225), `check:i18n-coverage` and `check:type-check-debt` (build prerequisites and the shared lock; green on rerun, `426 baselined, none new` and `0 raw tsc error(s)`). - NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits `3`, the prerequisite refusal, because packages this diff does not touch have no local `dist`. CI's build lane runs it. - Repo-wide `pnpm lint`: exit `0`, run locally after the PR opened. - Not run locally, left to CI: the `@objectstack/cli` `integration` vitest layer (no integration-tier file is touched).
